t: This is a statue of John Cass, a lead figure by the sculptor Louis-François Roubiliac. Cass was an English merchant, Tory Member of Parliament and philanthropist. He was also a key figure in the Royal African Company, which was involved in the Atlantic slave trade, and that is part of how he is remembered today. The original statue, made in 1751, stands in the Guildhall. The version at the School of Art, Architecture and Design on Jewry Street, part of London Metropolitan University, is a fibreglass replica installed in 1998.
